evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal mandate framing ('every new hire completes') enacts authority-ranking: a uniform requirement imposed on all newcomers, not a reciprocal or proportional arrangement.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Reporting a supersession of a prior system by a new one enacts authority-ranking: the new checklist displaced the old wiki, a hierarchical replacement of one governance structure by another.
